text:
Ah, wait a minute. I did not want a full refund, because I actually liked the shoes very much and wanted to keep them! I only wanted the missing belt, or at least a partial refund for the belt alone, since the combo price was Rs 4,499. 

Could you please cancel this full refund and instead do the needful to send me the matching belt, or process a partial refund for that item only? Kindly escalate this to your supervisor if needed.
